summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a 6-K attaching a news release reporting results of its 2026 annual general and special meeting held October 2, 2026. Holders of 123,182,474 common shares, 55.69% of outstanding, were represented. All items passed: six directors elected (Rui Feng 98.86% for; Paul Simpson lowest at 83.76%), a special resolution amending Articles to align with Hong Kong listing rules (95.74% for), an amended share-based compensation plan (84.51% for), and Deloitte LLP re-appointed auditor. No special-situation event; routine meeting results with no deal terms.
